# Clinical Practice Decision

This folder covers specific clinical practice decisions and structured interventions implemented within the Danish healthcare system for the management of atrial fibrillation. It documents both localized operational choices, such as emergency reception practices at specific hospitals, and systemic quality metrics used to monitor long-term treatment adherence and patient education. Together, these pages illustrate how clinical pathways are adapted locally and measured nationally to optimize care for atrial fibrillation patients.

## Pages

- [[clinical-practice-decision|Clinical Practice Decision]] — Explores localized operational choices and systemic quality indicators, such as long-term anticoagulation adherence metrics, used to manage and evaluate atrial fibrillation care.
- [[struktureret-undervisningsprogram|Struktureret undervisningsprogram]] — Details the structured educational program for newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients, which is tracked nationally as a formal process indicator with a minimum 50% quality standard.
